integrity: The theorem is proved symbolically for arbitrary finite nonempty S and all positive coprime targets. The bundled finite computation is a regression check only and is not used as proof of an infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only positive targets coprime to the product of the primes in S. Targets divisible by an S-prime can have higher S-adic exponents and are not classified here. The literature search cannot logically exclude every unindexed equivalent formulation.
title: Exact coprime-target fibers of finite arithmetic subderivatives
